summary.text: Routable (desk-verified against the PLATEAU 2023 survey geometry and official 2022/2026 maps; not field-verified; opening hours unknown): slice 1, the B1 Central Passage from the JR Central Gates east to Exits 27/34/35/36/37/42/43; slice 2, the passage along the JR east side to the South Passage east end and the south-east corridor to Exits 38/39/40/41; slice 3, the passage along the JR east side north to the North Passage (Exit 22, 東口（北）) and the passage between the Ikebukuro Shopping Park blocks to Exits 26/28/32/33; slice 4, the Central Passage west to the West Exit (西口) underground hall and its passages to Exits 10/11/15/17/18; slice 5, the South Passage west past the JR South Gate to the West Exit (South) hall (Exit 4, routed to the foot of its stairs, which are outside the survey) and the passage north to the West Exit hall. The rest of the PLATEAU B1 passage network is visible but not accessible (access unverified); access fences stop free walking there. Exits 4, 13 and 36 are routed only to the foot of their stairs; the stairs themselves are not part of the route. Fare-paid concourses and platforms are not modelled.

ルート案内対象（PLATEAU 2023年計測形状と公式案内図による机上検証。現地未確認、営業時間不明）：第1区画 中央通路（JR中央改札付近）から東側出口27・34・35・36・37・42・43；第2区画 JR東側通路から南通路東端、南東通路の出口38・39・40・41；第3区画 JR東側通路から北通路（出口22・東口（北））、池袋ショッピングパーク間の通路の出口26・28・32・33；第4区画 中央通路（西）から西口地下広場、出口10・11・15・17・18；第5区画 南通路（西）・JR南改札から西口（南）地下広場（出口4は計測範囲外の階段の下まで案内）、西口地下広場への通路。その他のB1地下通路は表示のみで立入不可（アクセス未確認のため、フェンスで進入を止めています）。出口4・13・36は階段の下までの案内で、階段自体はルートに含まれません。改札内・ホームは未モデル化。

Exit 9's flight lies ~9 m from its map position; the (-181, 126) flight sits beside the wide stair to the Fukutoshin Line West Passage, and the (-165, 113) flight runs into the Hope Center block towards Exit 7's map position, so neither is matched. assets.derivation: tools/gis context-overlay run overlay-ikebukuro-r700-ikebukuro-station-enu-v0-station-railway-70f286365793c8e9acf3 (receipt docs/gis/context/overlay-ikebukuro-r700-ikebukuro-station-enu-v0-station-railway-70f286365793c8e9acf3.json): station and railway geometry, coarse kind and feature hash only, clipped to a 700 m origin disc; no name, code or attribute; rendered 0.02 m above its z basis as a scene-side render offset, not data z

PLATEAU CityGML LOD4.1 -> pipeline/extract_plateau_ubld.py (ENU) -> pipeline/blender_build_glb.py (triangulated, metric UV0); renderer frame (x, z, -y), identity transform; collision comes from per-mesh gteki_role tags (floor/stairs_ramps walkable; wall/barriers/transport collide), not from the asset role, because verified exit routes pass through door and portal panels; runtime variant assets/ikebukuro_b1_lit.glb (listed in files, not a second asset, so loaders that load every asset never stack both): the same geometry + generated ceiling LED fixtures (GTEki art direction, not surveyed) -> pipeline/blender_bake_lighting.py: second UV set (TEXCOORD_1) and a Cycles diffuse lightmap (assets/ikebukuro_b1_lightmap.webp / _2k.webp, gamma-2.2 encoded, scale in ikebukuro_b1_lit.meta.json). scene/scene.ts loads the lit variant and falls back to this GLB; kit/{high,low}/*.glb: Lane E kit pieces (see source gteki-kit-0-1-0) copied unmodified by pipeline/sync_kit.py and instanced by scene/kit.ts on the access-fence label stretches and, for the two column pieces, by scene/kit_columns.ts as sleeves on the PLATEAU column footprints in scene/columns.json (finish generic, not surveyed), visual only, no colliders; gteki_gate_array_2 (kit/{high,low}/): ONE generic array per node at g_jr_c1, g_jr_c2 and g_jr_s, anchored on the node with its aisles along the verified edge's arriving direction, visual only, no colliders, not in the walk graph. 「代表性擺設，通道數與方向未驗證」 / "representative placement; aisle count and orientation unverified": the aisle count, direction and side are guesses, not a surveyed layout; scene/kit_signs.ts stretches the generic sign frame around the existing sign faces; presentation only, never walkable or colliders

PLATEAU bldg (LOD1 low / LOD2 high) and tran (road geometry only) -> tools/gis: `gis context-glb ikebukuro --variant low --merge tiles:380` (assets/ikebukuro_context_low.glb, 8 meshes, 30,418 tris; receipt docs/gis/context/context-ikebukuro-r250-x120-ikebukuro-station-enu-v0-low-tiles380-daebc9ca51cbeea3c90a.json) and `gis context-glb ikebukuro --variant high --merge tiles:380` (assets/ikebukuro_context_high.glb, 8 meshes, 139,525 tris; receipt docs/gis/context/context-ikebukuro-r250-x120-ikebukuro-station-enu-v0-high-tiles380-015891c342423501b9d1.json); the high file is listed in files, not a second asset, so loaders that load every asset never stack both. Committed bytes equal the receipts: ikebukuro_context_low.glb sha256 0629b00cf18a57f816d341c871052fd19f835e39ffdfc445058a216346d5487c (2,266,864 B), ikebukuro_context_high.glb sha256 ad55b6da91ae7c8960db789cc6e654043735736bbf5e813f904c15a6519dcdb6 (9,488,428 B). Station ENU frame, TP heights, whole features, no textures, no tran attributes. Roads ship as geometry only under the Owner's risk acceptance (docs/gis/decisions/2026-10-22-plateau-tran-geometry-risk-acceptance.md). Every node is gteki_role=context, named ctx_bldg_* or ctx_road_*, NOT_FOR_ROUTING, visual_only: never walkable, never a collider, never a camera blocker. scene/scene.ts loads the variant matching ctx.quality in the background and shows it only when the camera is near street level.

dataFiles.derivation: pipeline/build_signage.py: sign positions, facing and arrows from verified edge geometry and routing (gteki/graph.json); placement against PLATEAU ceiling and wall surfaces (build/ubld_enu.json), with continuous 6-10 m full-face sight-line envelopes from the 1.62 m walker eye and default follow camera against the shipped lit GLB walls/ceiling/barriers/light_fixtures and scene/columns.json kit sleeves (nearest clear candidate, otherwise retained and reported blocked); exit and gate names/labels from gteki/pois.json (names only, no source sign layout reproduced). sourceIds = every verified edge's geometry/access evidence and its end nodes' sourceRefs, plus the evidence of each exit and gate a sign shows (a wide set)

pipeline/build_station.py crowd_lanes(): per verified edge (gteki/graph.json geometry), the lateral width a pedestrian may stand off the polyline, sampled on the PLATEAU walkable grid (build/ubld_enu.json, >= 0.35 m from walls) inside the routable coverage areas (data/graph.src.json). sourceIds = PLATEAU, the routable areas' sources and every verified edge's geometry/access evidence and end nodes' sourceRefs (a wide set)

pipeline/build_walkfix.py: thin invisible quads bridging hairline cracks (< 0.30 m, same height within 0.06 m) between adjacent PLATEAU floor and stair-tread polygons (build/ubld_enu.json); they change neither the graph nor the rendered geometry

pipeline/build_access.py: fence pieces and 'access unverified' label stretches along the outline of the routable coverage areas (data/graph.src.json) where PLATEAU floor (build/ubld_enu.json) lies beside it; verified edge geometry (gteki/graph.json) is only checked for clearance and does not shape the output. sourceIds = PLATEAU and the routable areas' sources
GTEki-authored finish-pack config (role → texture folder + repeat in metres); empty today; no external source

GTEki-authored kit placement config (which library pieces the scene places, their use, pitch and the representative gate-array label); the pieces themselves are assets[] files (gteki/kit/**); no external source

pipeline/extract_columns.py: PLATEAU column footprints and heights found by shape in the barriers triangles (build/ubld_enu.json, welded vertical prisms 1.5 m or taller, up to 3 m across), each with its kit sleeve piece id or null and a reason. sourceIds = PLATEAU
